conclusion: Killing the primary cost active-passive a median 111 failed requests over a 2217.2 ms gap with no successes, while active-active lost only 1 and kept serving (gap 35.9 ms), but its surviving server's p95 latency rose from 79.1 ms to 87.8 ms under double load.
setup: in-process simulation, virtual clock; 50 req/s for 30 s, primary killed at 10 s; 2 servers x 2 workers, service 8 ms + exp(mean 22 ms), hop 1 ms; active-passive: health check every 1000 ms, switch after 3 failures, cold standby +30 ms fading over 50 requests; active-active: round-robin, drop server on first failed request, no retries; 5 runs per mode, seeds 1100 to 1104, median, min and max reported for every measurement
